name: Water-wheel-powered millstone (phase 1: materials; phase 2 geometry is designed by the overseer afterwards)
pack: Create: Perfect World Post Production - Better FPS (MC 1.21.1, NeoForge, Create 6.0.9 per the installed jar)
facts: Existing: millstone at 1085,64,-328 with a hand crank directly under it at 1085,63,-328 (millstone takes rotation from below). Crafting tables near 1082,64,-331 and 1089,57,-329; furnace placed near the surface.
Pond (still water, y=62) at x1098..1101, z-333..-330. Still water does not turn a wheel: phase 2 digs a trench so water flows past it.

Recipes (verified in the installed jar): water_wheel = 8 planks + 1 shaft; gearbox = andesite_casing in the middle with cogwheels above, below, left, right; cogwheel = shaft + plank; andesite_alloy = 2 andesite + 2 iron nuggets (diagonal); andesite_casing = andesite_alloy applied to a stripped log.

steps.name: 2 acacia logs
steps.goal: Chop 2 acacia logs (mc_find_blocks #minecraft:logs radius 32 exposedOnly, then mc_mine). Do not touch the machines near x=1085,z=-328.

steps.name: planks to 13
steps.goal: Craft planks from exactly ONE of the logs (open inventory with mc_screen; mc_craft acacia_planks) so that you hold at least 13 acacia planks. Keep the other log: it becomes the casing.

steps.name: 3 andesite
steps.goal: Mine andesite until you hold 3. Use mc_find_blocks andesite radius 32 exposedOnly and pick the nearest. Stone gives cobblestone, which is fine.

steps.name: 1 andesite alloy
steps.goal: Craft 1 create:andesite_alloy (2 andesite + 2 iron nuggets; needs a crafting table: place one or use one nearby).

steps.name: andesite casing
steps.goal: Place the acacia log, strip it with the stone axe (hold it, look at the log, mc_interact use), then hold the andesite alloy and mc_interact use on the stripped log to make a casing block; mine it to pick it up.

steps.name: 4 cogwheels
steps.goal: At a crafting table craft create:cogwheel 4 times (1 create:shaft + 1 plank each).

steps.name: gearbox
steps.goal: At a crafting table craft create:gearbox (andesite casing in the middle, a cogwheel above, below, left and right of it; mc_craft handles the layout).

steps.name: water wheel
steps.goal: At a crafting table craft create:water_wheel (8 planks around 1 shaft).

phase2.design: Water flows across the TOP of the wheel (no trench, no falling water). Wheel axis z; water cells O and C' above/beside it.

cells.water_O: 1097,62,-332 (grass now; mine LAST with allowFluids; adjacent to pond source 1098,62,-332)
cells.water_Cprime: 1096,62,-332 (dug out first, becomes flowing water over the wheel)

stages: A: build everything, water closed (verify with mc_blocks)
B: open water (mine O with allowFluids), insert cobblestone into the millstone, wait
C: collect output; success = gravel increases with nobody cranking
phase2.notes: Gearbox is needed because the wheel axis is horizontal and the millstone takes rotation from below (vertical axis). Water wheel needs FLOWING water; the pond is still.

phase1_result: PASSED (verified by overseer via mc_observe): water_wheel 1, gearbox 1, shaft 2. Haiku player: 44 tool calls, ~3 min.
phase2_result: PASSED: gravel 1 -> 13 (cobblestone 33 -> 21) with water-driven millstone, no cranking. Verified by overseer via mc_observe. Corrections found: millstone input is by dropping items on top; gearbox must be placed as create:vertical_gearbox to get axis x; player body must not overlap the target cell.
